messages.text: What warehouse is this shipping from? Trying to understand final shipping cost.

It ships from our warehouse, drop-shipped direct, so it travels in its own parcel. Shipping on those is a flat worldwide rate by weight — $30 up to 4 kg, $40 to 8 kg, $50 to 12 kg, and up from there. Checkout shows the exact figure once you add your address.

Where's it shipping to?

Good — US delivery, so no import VAT or duty. Just the flat shipping bracket plus sales tax if Illinois applies it, both shown at checkout.

One honest note: the Avalon Q isn't a unit we recommend. For a home setup we point people to the Harlo B30 ($899, ~30 TH/s) or the Magic Miner 40T ($799), both quieter and far better value per TH.

Where would it be running — office, garage?

A cool basement is the best spot for one — intake air that cold keeps the chips happy and the fans slower, so it's quieter too.

That points me at the Harlo B30, $899, ~30 TH/s, redesigned cooling and the enclosed build is the quiet one.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll run the sats and the power cost side by side.

Solar changes the math in your favour — the sats you stack are yours and the power's already paid for. That's the best case for one of these.

The B30 pulls ~360–450 W, about 50 dB, $899, ships Nov 30. Shipping is $40 at its weight.

Every ten minutes it's a fresh draw at a full block, and you keep the machine. Want me to build the cart?
I hey 30 th for 899 or 90th for 1349?

Per TH the Avalon Q looks cheaper, true. But it's a loud, high-draw industrial-style box, not something we stand behind in a basement — it's not a unit we recommend at all.

The honest value play is the Magic Miner 40T: 40 TH/s for $799, cheapest per TH we sell, ships Nov 21. The B30 is the quieter, more refined build at $899, ships Nov 30.

Quiet matters to you, or raw TH per dollar?
raw th. won't hear the miner in the basement. the area is walled off 10 x 50ft form the main part of the basement.

Then the Magic Miner 40T is your unit. $799, 40 TH/s at ~650 W, and it's tunable — Turbo gives you 50 TH/s at 850 W, which is $16 per TH. In a walled-off cool room you can run Turbo and never think about the noise.

Ships Nov 21, Batch 6. Shipping $40 at its weight.
